title: EGGPlacer: Energy-Guided Generative Chip Placement with Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chip placement strongly affects routed wirelength and thermal behavior, yet these downstream metrics are difficult to evaluate during macro placement. Learning-based macro placers commonly optimize the macro-only half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL), denoted mHPWL, which ignores standard cell connectivity and spatial demand. In contrast, analytical mixed-size placers optimize differentiable full netlist wirelength and density objectives but are typically unaware of thermal effects. We propose EGGPlacer, an energy-guided diffusion framework that incorporates analytical placement feedback and thermal feedback into macro placement generation. An analytical placer acts as an online physical response model, exposing the standard cell distribution and a full netlist wirelength proxy induced by each intermediate macro placement, while a differentiable thermal model provides temperature feedback. These signals are formulated as composable energies

translated_title: EGGPlacer：基于扩散模型的能量引导生成式芯片布局
translated_abstract: 芯片布局强烈影响布线线长和热行为，然而这些下游指标在宏单元布局过程中难以评估。基于学习的宏单元布局器通常仅优化宏单元半周长线长（mHPWL），该方法忽略了标准单元的连接性和空间需求。相比之下，解析式混合尺寸布局器优化可微分的全网表线长和密度目标，但通常不考虑热效应。我们提出 EGGPlacer，一个能量引导的扩散框架，将解析布局反馈和热反馈融入宏单元布局生成过程中。解析布局器充当在线物理响应模型，揭示标准单元分布以及由每个中间宏单元布局引起的全网表线长代理指标，同时可微分热模型提供温度反馈。这些信号被表述为可组合的能量
tldr: 提出EGGPlacer，一个能量引导的扩散框架，通过将解析布局器的全网表线长反馈和可微分热模型的温度反馈作为可组合能量，生成兼顾布线线长与热行为的宏单元布局。
en_tdlr: EGGPlacer is an energy-guided diffusion framework that generates macro placements optimizing both full netlist wirelength and thermal behavior by incorporating analytical placement feedback and differentiable thermal feedback as composable energies.
